20 top-level pin name(s) declared on both sides were anchored by name before comparing (options.anchor_top_level_pins): each one's layout net is asserted to match the reference net of the same-named pin, which the comparer's own topology-only net pairing does not otherwise require. Without it, two boundary nets with identical topology (e.g. two bits of a black-box macro's bus) are interchangeable and a swap between them compares clean -- see docs/cli/lvs.md, "Top-level pin anchoring"
